source: Cervino Ski Paradise piste map 2026-27 (cervinia.it): Zermatt, Breuil-Cervinia and Valtournenche, coloured number badges read automatically and checked against the printed piste list
lifts_source: Zermatt side: Zermatt Bergbahnen winter timetable 2026/27 (www.matterhornparadise.ch/ZBAG/17-PDF/flyer/flyer-winter/2026-2027/fahrplan_winter 2026_27.pdf), every lift as printed (Snowpark, restaurants and the Glacier Palace left out; Leisee-Shuttle listed without the Wollipark play area). Added from the same company's lift status page (www.matterhornparadise.ch/en/information/lifts-and-pistes, 2026-11-23): the Matterhorn Express sections, the three Plateau Rosa drag lifts, the four Gornergrat Bahn sections and the Breuil-Cervinia lifts it listed that day. Valtournenche and the rest of the Cervinia side are not covered (the status page listed only lifts scheduled that day), fetched 2026-11-23

lifts_explained.Furi – Riffelberg: the map's Riffelberg-Express gondola (Furi to Riffelberg)
lifts_explained.Furi – Schwarzsee: the map's Matterhorn Express 2 (Furi to Schwarzsee)
lifts_explained.Schwarzsee – Trockener Steg: the map's Matterhorn Express 3 (Schwarzsee - Furgg) and 4 (Furgg - Trockener Steg): the timetable gives the two sections as one line
lifts_explained.Zermatt - Riffelalp: the map's Gornergrat Bahn sections Zermatt – Findelbach and Findelbach – Riffelalp (the status page gives them as one)
lifts_explained.Leisee-Shuttle: short inclined lift at Sunnegga down to the Leisee lake and the Wollipark children's area (OpenStreetMap ways 359525366 and 359525370, railway=funicular, half a minute). The build takes rail lifts only when listed under extra_lifts in the config; small lift, opens no terrain of its own, so it was not added
lifts_explained.Theodul Express: on the 2026/27 timetable (Matterhorn Glacier Paradise - Schwarzsee area, open from 19.12.2026) but not in OpenStreetMap under this name and not placed on our map. Our map's Furgg - Sandiger Boden chair (OpenStreetMap way 22341536) is not on the timetable; whether the Theodul Express replaced or renamed it is not known. Check before adding or removing anything
